product_metadata.title: TashiBox [8 oz-50 Sets Plastic food storage containers with lids airtight, BPA Free, Microwave/Dishwasher/Freezer Safe
features: ❤【8 oz, 50 Sets】Plastic containers for food storage with airtight lids which is perfect for food storage. These kitchen containers will NEVER leak, crack or warp.
❤【100% BPA Free】Deli containers with lids are made from BPA-free, eco-friendly polypropylene plastic. No Toxins. Deli container can be used with confidence.
❤【Heated & Frozen】TashiBox quart containers are safe for the microwave and freezer. Great as travel containers, lunch containers, soup containers, to-go containers and food storage containers.
❤【Reusable Containers】Deli cups are safe for dishwasher. Since freezer containers for soup are washable, many customers use them for making homemade slime!
❤【Stackable Storage】Unique design and perfect restaurant containers to be stackable and easy to store when not in use. Save more space.
